# Copilot code review — devantler.tech monorepo

This repo is the **devantler.tech Astro Starlight docs site** (`docs/`) plus the portfolio monorepo:
every product as a Git submodule and the autonomous **Daily AI Assistant** brain in `.claude/`.
Canonical conventions live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md); this is the concise review checklist —
flag violations of the rules below.

## Always (every PR)

- **Conventional-Commit PR title** (`feat:`/`fix:`/`docs:`/`ci:`/`chore:`/`refactor:`/`test:`). The
  squash-merge title feeds the changelog, so a non-conventional or bracket-prefixed title is a defect.
- **Root-cause fixes only.** Flag anything that masks a failure instead of fixing it: checks skipped or
  set `continue-on-error` to dodge red CI, deleted or weakened assertions, `--no-verify`, silenced linters.
- **Never hand-edit generated files.** Here: `docs/package-lock.json` (let npm regenerate it) and
  submodule pointers (they often show as modified but are **not** part of a normal content PR — flag
  an unexplained pointer bump).
- **Behaviour / flag / command / config / UX change ⇒ its docs updated in the same PR.** A missing doc
  update is a review finding.
- **No secrets in plaintext** — flag committed tokens, keys, or kubeconfigs.
- PRs from the Daily AI Assistant carry a `> 🤖 Generated by the Daily AI Assistant` line — expected,
  not a finding.

## Docs site (`docs/`, Astro + Starlight)

- Content is MDX/Markdown under `docs/src/content/docs/`. Check valid frontmatter, one `#` H1 with no
  skipped heading levels, descriptive link text, and alt text on images.
- Prefer **relative internal links**; `starlight-links-validator` runs at build, so a dead internal
  link or anchor breaks CI — flag obvious ones.
- The build must pass (`cd docs && npm ci && npm run build`); flag changes that would break it (bad
  MDX, missing imports, malformed `astro.config.mjs`).
- Don't duplicate a product's own docs into the site — link out (e.g. KSail → ksail.devantler.tech).
  Don't rewrite blog posts under `docs/src/content/docs/blog/`.
- It's a public site: keep WCAG-AA contrast, the skip-link, and ARIA intact.

## Agent & instruction files (`.claude/`, `AGENTS.md`, this file)

- These steer the autonomous assistant and AI reviewers. Keep them **internally consistent**: a changed
  command, path, label, or convention in `AGENTS.md` must match the corresponding `.claude/` skill/agent,
  product card, and `copilot-instructions.md` — flag drift in either direction.
- Copilot code review reads `.github/copilot-instructions.md` + `.github/instructions/**/*.instructions.md`
  at **≤4000 chars each** and does **not** read `AGENTS.md` — so keep this file concise and standalone;
  flag a PR that bloats it past the limit or relies on `AGENTS.md` being read here.

## GitHub Actions / CI

- Pin third-party actions; keep workflows `actionlint`-clean. Bundle dependency bumps and call out majors.

When unsure, defer to [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and the relevant submodule's `AGENTS.md ## Maintenance`.
